title: nbn FTTP or HFC 750/50Mbps: Carbon Network $89/Month, ABB Direct Network $95/Month @ Carbon Comms
body:
Deal: nbn FTTP or HFC 750/50Mbps: Carbon Network $89/Month, ABB Direct Network $95/Month @ Carbon Comms

[Disabled-User] $2? That's like 4 bus rides where I come from.
[OZKap] I thought this was OzBargain and not OzBetterThanNothing
[Frunk] I'm sure more people would agree that 50% off sounds better than $2 off.
Also it's "than" not "then".
[Frunk] Oh wow, the dirty comment delete & post edit to remove references to the $2 saving. That's pretty deceptive. Have a neg.
https://i.imgur.com/oizqa5b.png
[carboncomms] well actually i just agreed with what was being said so i made an edit. it's not Spam nor is it deceptive. Just advising of a deal for people.
[Ultraman] Considering all your previous offers that I admit were tempting for me to consider joining CC, this $2 saving on your normal price is actually quite disgusting, especially since you understand this is Ozbargain, not OzAdvertisingBoard? Pretty much spam - since you know exactly what you're doing.
[carboncomms] @Ultraman you are entitled to have an opinion and so am I. $89 ongoing for a service with No CGNAT, Static IP included for 750/50 service is a good deal. Me taking $2 off my retail price for the sake of existing and new customers is my decision not yours!! ABB Direct NBN 750/50 with No CGNAT and IPv6 included at $95 is a deal.
So once again your entitled to your opinion and so am I.
If i chose to list my price is also advising existing customers they get the new rate as well.
Say what you say but at the end I'm here to help people get a good service!!
[carboncomms] I actually went to correct a typo from than to then and hit unpublished if you want my complete honesty. But whatever happy to be judged doesn't bother me either way!!
[carboncomms] @Fluffy Bunny no nothing for Black Friday!! Mainly ongoing monthly plans
[Fluffy Bunny] Hope you reassess your pricing to keep ozbargain spirit alive.
